notes.title: Unexpected Downtime and Recovery Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

For players who may have missed our updates on social media and updates on our Steam Forums, we want to provide a full recap of what has been happening behind the scenes over the past few weeks and share the latest progress on restoring our servers.

On February 2nd, all three of our world wide data centers went dark and all our servers went offline without notice. We were informed by our primary network hosting provider they had encountered a serious issue requiring an unspecified amount of days to fix. This forced Fallen Earth and GamersFirst offline. Unfortunately, we were not provided with an ETA at the time, but we immediately began working with our provider to resolve the issue.

After ongoing discussions, we were initially told services would be restored by Friday, February 7th. However, as delays continued, and deadlines were missed, we made the very difficult decision to terminate all services and implement an entirely new hosting solution to regain control over our infrastructure and ensure long-term stability.

This process has involved quickly securing all of our existing servers, acquiring new servers to meet player demand, and kicking off multiple network colocation and transit contracts around the world. Once we secured new servers, our team began working on restoring services.

As of right now, here is what we have accomplished for Fallen Earth, APB Reloaded and GamersFirst:
[list]
[*] 2/21 (Friday): Network circuits were scheduled for provisioning and activation.
[*] 2/24 (Monday): Hosting cabinets were finalized and handed over for setup.
[*] Server Racking Begins: We moved and racked all the necessary hardware for both NA and EU data centers.[/list]
All servers in North America have been set up, and we are currently waiting for one final part before going live.

In Europe, hardware has been moved to Amsterdam, racked, and plugged in. We are now waiting on circuit activation. Our CEO is currently in Amsterdam, tirelessly overseeing everything to ensure a smooth transition. Our team is actively working on-site in both locations to complete the setup as quickly as possible.

We truly appreciate the patience and support from our dedicated players. This transition has been a massive undertaking, and we are doing everything possible to ensure that APB Reloaded and Fallen Earth return stronger than before.

We are posting regular updates on our Discord, and we welcome everyone to join us there for the latest news and discussions: discord.gg/littleorbit


We will continue providing updates via Steam, Discord, and social media as we approach the final stages of this process.

Thank you for being patient with us and we'll see you back in-game soon!

notes.title: Fallen Earth servers going offline 10/2
notes.notes:
Hi all, 
  
Today is a very bittersweet day. 
  
In the coming weeks prior to September 22nd, we will be launching the first all new event in honor of the 10 year anniversary for Fallen Earth. We hope that players will enjoy what we have planned, because this will now be their last chance to play the current game with their friends. 
  
Effective 10/2 (or there about based on when the event goes live), we will be taking the Fallen Earth servers offline. 
  
Unfortunately after weeks of monitoring things and getting players feedback, we have determined the current state of Fallen Earth just isn't sustainable in its current form. 

You guys have been very tolerant, but the player experience is terrible right now. It's laggy and buggy. Servers crash quite often, and stacking is still disabled due to exploits.  We don't blame the player base for the low concurrency numbers. You need a better game to play. 
  
For clarity, we are still committed to the new version of the game that we have been working on. However we are still very early into development, so there isn't a timeline that can be provided yet.
  
We want to personally thank everyone for their support over the last 17 months. Fallen Earth is still one of our CEO's favorite projects. We look forward to giving it the proper attention it deserves. 
  
Sincerely, 
Little Orbit

The holidays are officially ﻿here!  
  
[h1]The Grunch Event - December 12[/h1]
  
[I]"I hate all those Whoms! How they sing and they shout! I'd love to destroy them, and rip their guts out!"[/I] The Grunch had an idea! An awful idea! The Grunch had a wonderful, awful idea! 
  
Grunches and Whoms have invaded the Wasteland! Seek out Cindy Loom Whom, found in Spider Hill, New Flagstaff, Trader’s Flat and Los Alamos. If you can stop the Grunch and bring back some of the xmas gifts he stole Cindy will give you a special holiday reward. [h1]First Night - December 19 - January 2[/h1]
  
Since the Fall, computer glitches and leap years have created controversy over the actual date of the New Year. For decades now, people in all areas of the Grand Canyon Province have used different dates, leading to much confusion. Now, the Archivist Coalition, with the help of LifeNet, has finally determined the actual date of the New Year. In the process of their research, the Coalition has also uncovered a great deal of information about various holidays that had been celebrated in the past. In honor of the establishment of the true date, the Coalition is sponsoring “First Night” a festival that combines many of the holidays past. 
  
There might not be any snow in the Wasteland, but citizens from all over the Grand Canyon Province can join together, build some Dirtmen, and wait for the arrival of S.A.N.T.A (the Seasonal Arctic Network of Toy-based Altruism). They’ve been keeping track of who's naughty and nice. The nice get gifts and the naughty get hunted down. Hope you were nice! There will be plenty more celebrating where that came from, as well as holiday missions and goodies. Enjoy party crackers, fruitcake, and festive top hats from gift boxes, or trade the unopened boxes in for a chance to win the ultra-rare white top hat.

notes.title: Marketplace purchases during rollback & server downtime gifts.

This past week Fallen Earth has had some issues that affected server stability which ultimately resulted in additional downtime. These issues have been fixed and the team is actively monitoring the servers to make sure no additional problems arise. The Fallen Earth team apologizes for the inconvenience and to make up for the lost time we are sending you one week of Commander Premium and 2 GT Supply Boxes!
 
To get your Commander Premium just login to the Fallen Earth Marketplace and redeem code PassTheStuffing. You can also pick up your two GT Supply Boxes by going to the redeem code page, you will see the two codes there in your list of available promo codes.
 
Many that were opted out didn't receive the original email and had trouble redeeming the 2 GT boxes, this has now been corrected. 
 
Also, any purchases from the Marketplace from  11/25/2014 12:25:00 AM  - 11/26/2014 11:00:00 AM (during the rollback time) have been refunded and also were given the item they purchased for free. We apologize for the delay in getting this sorted out, however the holiday made things take longer than expected. 
 
If you have a ticket into support about either of the above issues and it is now resolved, please reply to your current ticket and let us know so we can move through the influx of tickets quicker and get to those that are requiring other assistance. 
 
Happy Holidays!

notes.title: Coffee induced update
notes.notes: We were near the home stretch and had a portion of the backup fail. We've now restarted that portion and are estimating that the server should be up at approximately 7 pm provided all goes well.  Thank you all for your patience during this outage, we will not stop until the server is back in service.

notes.title: Server Rollback Update
notes.notes: Update:  We are on the last steps of the rollback process. While we cannot give an exact time of when the server will be back in service,  we have been working all night to ensure that we are open as soon as safely possible

notes.title: Server downtime 11/25
notes.notes: We've identified a major issue with the previous fix. We'll be taking the server down for a rollback to a previous server save. Estimated downtime 5 hours. We will be sending out 7 days premium to all that logged in within the last 90 days.

notes.title: Update Server Downtime -
notes.notes:
The Fallen Earth servers are coming back in service and we apologize for the unexpected downtime. We have isolated a problem with the Auction House that was causing lag in various forms (chat, item, spawning). All items on that were placed on the Auction House will fall under one of these categories:

1. if your auction had a buyout price, you'll be receiving that buyout instead of getting the item back
2. if there is no buyout price and no bidder, we're sending the items back to the owner for the Auction. Bids and posting fees should be returned as normal by the auction system. 
3. if you were the highest bidder on an auction, you'll receive the item . 

This will happen over the course of the next 4 hours. 

We will be sending out compensation to all players that have logged in over the last 90 days. Please watch for this to the email address that is registered for your Fallen Earth account.

Thank you for your patience and we will continually monitor the servers over the next few days to ensure their stability.
